df_cutin_key.design: Native CutinEnv road and dense lane-0 traffic with independent random native type labels. The nearest native vehicle behind the ego is kept as the key; its native label is preserved and its initial speed/target speed are set by that label. Aggressive keys approach at 10.5 m/s and force after the ego starts crossing; Normal keys keep native cooperative IDM; Cautious keys yield. In alternating seeds (even list index, independent of key type), three constant-speed native vehicles are placed in lane 1 at -6.5, -12.5 and +6.5 m relative to the ego (speeds 7, 7, 11 m/s). They are closer than the 22 m rear key at the first synchronous observation, so the nearest-three prompt omits the key; the controller's nearest-five set still contains it. Other lane-0 vehicles within [-40,+250] m of the ego are removed to open a merge corridor; all outside traffic and labels remain native. Ego starts in lane 1 at 7 m/s, the cut-in to lane 0 is required, and completion requires x>=310 m. No controller/reward/prompt change; the key response is type-scripted and variant-independent.
